content.title: Reason vs. Tradition
content.subtitle: Whose framework is more persuasive?
content.debate_prompt: Should a society reform its institutions by appeal to abstract reason, or preserve inherited traditions that have survived the test of time?

debate_options.position: Institutions should be redesigned from first principles whenever reason shows them to be unjust, because no tradition is sacred merely by being old and enduring injustice is still injustice.
Inherited customs encode hard-won practical wisdom, so reform should be gradual and respectful of precedent.
